instruction: I need to freeze the header row (row 11 with 'Employees', 'Clock-in', 'Clock-out') so it stays visible when scrolling through the employee list. Apply freeze panes and save the file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires freezing the header row (row 11) which contains column headers 'Employees', 'Clock-in', 'Clock-out'. The evaluator checks if freeze panes are set with freeze row >= 11. Verified from data: row 11 is the header row for the employee table.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts freeze panes state from XLSX file using openpyxl
Metric correctly validates that freeze panes are enabled and freeze row >= 11
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification using Ctrl+S
Complete coverage: verifies both freeze panes application and correct row position
